authority_chain: DH-03-HO1 frozen Phase5 exact-rule ledger/source binding
purpose: Non-decisional kill-screen only. Detect obvious incompatibility or absence of obvious proxy breach. This protocol cannot produce PROP-COMPAT-PASS, CONDITIONAL-PASS, challenge purchase authorization or live-trading authorization.

source.minute_archives: Use only exact Binance USD-M 1m URLs and SHA-256 values frozen in the Phase5 source gate; download only symbol-months intersecting resolved DH-03 positions; every downloaded archive must hash-match before use.
source.unresolved_trade_policy: Exclude the two execution-path-unresolved rows exactly as in the official Phase5 resolved metrics; do not impute exits.

account_model.no_leverage_cap_during_evaluation: Use only Hyro evaluation rules; funded exposure limits are checked separately as structural diagnostics.

execution_cost_cases.cost_timing: Entry half debited at entry; exit half debited at exit. No maker rebate or fee optimization.

funding.source: Exact canonical Binance USD-M historical funding files frozen in Phase5 source artifact
funding.event_window: events strictly after entry and strictly before exit

mark_to_market.daily_start_equity: Equity at 00:00 UTC using 1m open before any entry/funding/exit action timestamped at that minute; then intraday events are applied.
mark_to_market.intraminute_diagnostic: Synchronized 1m low across open long positions may be reported only as conservative drawdown upper-bound diagnostic and may not alone create OBVIOUS_PROXY_BREACH.

consistency.target_qualification_rule: Target may count as achieved only when total net realized profit >=10% initial balance, qualifying trading days >=5, and best positive realized UTC day profit <=40% of total positive net realized profit. If the ratio is above 40%, continue the unchanged replay; do not cap/rewrite the day post hoc.

inactivity.clock_start: first setup entry, representing challenge activation immediately before first frozen signal entry
inactivity.breach: elapsed time strictly greater than 30 days without a fully closed trade while challenge remains active
inactivity.evaluation_after_pass_or_breach: STOP; later history cannot retroactively change result

funded_structural_diagnostics.note: Diagnostics only. They do not convert a challenge proxy survivor into funded compatibility.

correlation_stress.calculation: n * frozen proxy risk percentage, before extra gap slippage; report against 4% daily and 6% maximum-loss amounts.

classification.OBVIOUS_PROXY_BREACH: At least one frozen grid x BASE/STRESS path breaches a mandatory challenge rule before qualifying pass; report every grid cell separately. No rescue by dropping failed cells.
classification.NO_OBVIOUS_PROXY_BREACH_BUT_EXACT_REPLAY: A grid cell reaches proxy pass before mandatory breach under the frozen assumptions. This is screening survival only and cannot authorize challenge purchase.
classification.PROXY_INSUFFICIENT: Required source path or rule application cannot be evaluated without an unfrozen assumption.

post_run_policy: Report all 10 grid/cost cells. Do not name a best risk size. Do not modify protocol based on results. Official PROP-COMPAT Phase3 remains locked.
